concepts.label: CAS-conditioned Advanced DELETE
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - genuinely new mechanism: the Advanced DELETE accessor's optional CAS field in `meta` gates success/failure (no CAS always succeeds; matching CAS succeeds; non-matching CAS or missing key fails), demonstrated via 4 explicit modes (no_cas/bad_cas/good_cas/no_key)

concepts.label: LCB_KEY_EEXISTS error
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - libcouchbase error surfaced by Advanced Accessor calls when a supplied CAS doesn't match the document's current CAS

concepts.label: LCB_KEY_ENOENT error
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - libcouchbase error surfaced by Advanced Accessor calls when the target document key does not exist
